summary.key_theme: Binance 交易所發生 63 億美元的重大駭客攻擊事件，導致市場恐慌並引發比特幣 ETF 出現大規模資金淨流出。

bullish.title: 'Incredible' That Bitcoin Outperformed Gold Last Week Despite $6.3 Billion Binance Hack, Says Analyst
bullish.reason: 分析師指出比特幣在面對歷史級別的駭客攻擊下，價格表現仍優於黃金，顯示出其資產類別的韌性。

bullish.title: 3 Reasons Why Bitcoin Is Worth Buying Right Now
bullish.reason: 儘管市場動盪，仍有觀點認為比特幣具備長期買入價值，為投資人提供正面信心支撐。

bearish.title: Investors Pull $643 Million From Bitcoin ETFs After the Biggest Crypto Hack in History
bearish.reason: Binance 遭駭事件導致投資人信心崩潰，單日從比特幣 ETF 撤資 6.43 億美元，直接衝擊 IBIT 的資產規模與股價。

bearish.title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $1 Billion as Midterms, Binance Hack Weigh on Sentiment
bearish.reason: 兩日內累計流出超過 10 億美元，顯示駭客事件與政治不確定性已對 ETF 資金流造成持續性壓力。

bearish.title: Binance's $6.3B Hack Sends Bitcoin ETF Tumbling 5%, but This ETF Is Up 21%: What's Driving the Divergence?
bearish.reason: 明確指出 IBIT 因 Binance 駭客事件導致股價單日下跌 5.24 %，反映出該事件對現貨 ETF 的直接負面影響。

bearish.title: BTC USD Holds $78,000 As OneKey’s Founder Warns North Korean Hackers May Already Have BlackRock’s IBIT on Their List
bearish.reason: 市場傳出駭客可能將目標轉向 BlackRock 的 IBIT，引發投資人對資產安全性的擔憂。

bearish.title: Bitcoin Price Today: BTC Fell to a 5-Week Low After $1.3 Billion in Longs Were Liquidated
bearish.reason: 高達 13 億美元的多頭部位遭到強制平倉，導致比特幣跌至五週低點，連帶拖累 IBIT 表現。

bearish.title: Bitcoin Looks Like A 'Relative Dud' Against Gold And US Treasuries, Says Bloomberg's Mike McGlone
bearish.reason: 彭博分析師認為比特幣自 2021 年以來的波動性與回報不成正比，相較於黃金與美債表現遜色。

neutral.title: Tether Says It Holds 150,000 Bitcoin, 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Showed
neutral.reason: Tether 持有量高於預期雖顯示市場需求，但對 IBIT 本身無直接財務關聯，僅為市場資訊。

neutral.title: Franklin Templeton Just Launched ETFs That Turn Stock Dividends Into Bitcoin
neutral.reason: 競爭對手推出新產品，顯示加密貨幣 ETF 生態系持續擴張，對 IBIT 影響中性。

neutral.title: MSBT: Cheap Bitcoin Exposure Still Depends On The ETF Plumbing
neutral.reason: 針對 Morgan Stanley 比特幣信託的分析，探討費用與流動性，對 IBIT 投資人參考價值有限。
